Commentary.Commentary: Right then. That’s it from the coverage of this game. Sri Lanka still has a game in hand to take a consolation win in the final T20I game of the series. India will be surely eyeing to complete another whitewash in 2022. The final game will be played on 27th at 1900 IST (1330 GMT). But as you all know you can join us early for the build-up. Till then take care and goodbye!

Shreyas Iyer wins the MAN OF THE MATCH AWARD for his exceptional effort with the blade. He says he loves to shuffle across in the crease but sometimes the bowler are smart enough to bowl a yorker. Adds that it was really important to time the ball. Kishan fell but Samson and Jadeja helped to build the partnership. Asked about Kumara bowling his third over, he wasn't thinking much about it. Mentions that the ball wasn't turning much so he started going big and it went with the flow.

Rohit Sharma, the victorious skipper, is in for a chat. On being asked about the tricky start, he says, seeing the middle order step up is really good to see. The guys are taking the responsibilities and completing the game with ease. Says, he does not want to blame the bowlers, the first 15 overs were really good but they need to work on their death bowling. Mentions, all the guys possess a lot of talent, and the side will make sure to give them ample opportunities. Adds, the kind of form Shreyas Iyer is in, it couldn’t get any better for the side. On being asked if he will make any changes for the final game. He jokingly replies and says that they will have a word tomorrow and come to a decision. Mentions they have a lot of players in their squad and they need to take care of every individual.

Dasun Shanaka, the Sri Lankan skipper says looking at the conditions, the score was a good one but they should have done better in the Powerplay. Adds they have a plan in bowling. Tells the game was set nicely for him to go guns-blazing in the death overs.
Stay tuned for the presentation...

Sanju Samson is in for a chat. He says the wicket was playing nicely and the boundaries were short. He didn't feel the score was a huge one and Shreyas Iyer helped him to get his rhythm. Tells that it's been a long time he played cricket so he needed to get used to the conditions. Informs it was cold out there. They are always told to keep their standards. The condition were difficult but they have enough experience. Ends by saying it is a big day for him as he made his debut 7 years ago today and he is grateful to help his team.

Sri Lanka could not continue the domination with the ball throughout the innings. Sri Lanka were off to a bright start as they sent back the Indian opening pair within the Powerplay. But once the spinners came into the attack. Shreyas Iyer took the bowlers for a ride. The bowlers could not keep things tight in the middle and ended up leaking away aplenty. By the end of the innings, it also looked like Sri Lanka dropped shoulders in the field. In the end, they could not falter the Indian batting attack. Lahiru Kumara picked up a brace.

What a brilliant show with the blade by Shreyas Iyer. He held the key for India during the chase and got his side over the line with the help of some knocks by Samson and Jadeja from the other end. India lost two wickets inside the Powerplay. One would’ve thought India would be in a lot of trouble with the ball swinging ferociously. But Shreyas Iyer applied himself really well and it looked like as if he was batting on some other deck. First, he built a solid stand with Sanju Samson to steady the ship and later, stitched another solid stand with Ravindra Jadeja to take a 2-nil lead in the series.

OH MY GOD! What an incredible chase by the Indian batters. At one point, it looked like India would slip out but a stand of 58 runs off 26 deliveries for the fourth wicket, made sure to seal the series for the hosts. Sri Lanka could not control the game even after taking quick wickets at the top. This is India's eleventh consecutive T20I victory.

FOUR! Extraordinary innings by Ravindra Jadeja and Shreyas Iyer! Made this chase look so easy. Fuller and outside off. Jadeja smashes it straight down to long off for a boundary. India win by 7 wickets and win the 3-match series by going 2-0 up.
Fullish delivery, outside off. Iyer moves across and tries to play the same shot as the previous one but misses. He has shown his class in this innings. Just 2 runs needed now.
FOUR! Deft touch! Yorker, outside off. Iyer shuffles again, opens the bat face and just helps it away past the keeper and short third man for a boundary.
A yorker, outside off. Shreyas steps across and tries to squeeze it out but misses.
Length ball, around off, pulled away to deep mid-wicket for a single. India one hit away now.
Full ball, on off. Iyer powers it to covers and the fielder there lets it through. A single.
Length ball, outside off. Jadeja guides it straight to the fielder at point.
Fuller ball, outside off. Jadeja gets underneath and lifts it towards extra cover for a single. Just 9 needed now.
Wide! Tries to stay away from the arc and serves it over the tramline. Left alone.
FOUR! Jadeja won't mind it! Full ball, outside off. Jadeja looks to drive but gets an outside edge to third man and beats the fielder at the fence as well. Hat-trick of boundaries.
FOUR! Jadeja is enjoying his time out there! Length again, on middle. Jadeja gets into the position quickly and pulls it to square leg for a boundary.
FOUR! India are in a hurry! A length ball, on middle. Jadeja pulls it hard and to mid-wicket for a boundary. 19 needed off 27 balls.

SIX! In the air and dropped! Sri Lankan fielding coach will be disappointed! Touch fuller, on middle. Jadeja lofts it straight, it gets the elevation and the fielder at the fence tries to take but the ball pops out and goes over the fence.
Sri Lankan players look tired! Fuller and on middle. Jadeja drills it to long on and the fielder there fumbles to collect it. Two taken.
Another single! A length ball, on the pads, Ravindra Jadeja flicks it to square leg for one more. India need almost a run a ball to get over the line.
Length ball, on off. Iyer pushes it to cover for one.
Full length, on off. Shreyas Iyer taps it to deep point for a brace.
A length ball, angled into off. Ravindra Jadeja stays back and steers it to third man for one.
Full length, on the pads. Ravindra Jadeja flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a brace.
WIDE! Poor from Binura Fernando. He cannot afford to give away any freebies. A slower bouncer, down leg. Ravindra Jadeja leaves it alone. Wide called.
FOUR! Down the ground. Ravindra Jadeja makes the most of the Free-Hit. Full length, on off. Ravindra Jadeja drives it down the ground to long on for a boundary.

FOUR! Ravindra Jadeja never takes time to find his rhythm. A length ball, outside off. Ravindra Jadeja stays back and punches it through point. It races away to the boundary. The umpire signals a no ball, as the bowler oversteps. Free Hit to follow.
Length ball, outside off. Ravindra Jadeja guides it down to third man for one.
Swing and a miss! Back of a length, on off. Ravindra Jadeja tries to heave it across the line but misses.
A short ball, on off. Shreyas Iyer stands tall and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Fuller, on off. Ravindra Jadeja pushes it to cover for one.
FOUR! What a shot! Full length, outside off. Ravindra Jadeja leans in and drives it through the cover region for a boundary.
Fuller, on middle and leg. Shreyas Iyer flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Ravindra Jadeja comes in now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Binura Fernando takes a blinder at slips. What a stunning catch to end a stunning knock by Sanju Samson. Full length, outside off. Sanju Samson throws his blade at it. The ball takes the outside edge and flies over Binura Fernando. He leaps high in the air and pouches the ball with his left hand. Binura Fernando cannot believe it. An eventful over comes to an end.
Commentary.Howout: c Binura Fernando b Lahiru Kumara

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! Third maximum of the over. Overpitched, on off, Sanju Samson gets under it and muscles it over the long off fence for a maximum.
Lahiru Kumara fires in a yorker, in the blockhole. Sanju Samson gets his blade down in time and digs it out.
SIX! All the way! Full length, outside off. Sanju Samson reaches out and smokes it over the cover fence for a biggie.
WIDE! A length ball, outside off. Sanju Samson tries to chase it but misses. Wide called.
SIX! This is Sanju Samson at it's best. A full-length ball, just outside off. Sanju Samson stands tall and smokes it over the long off fence for a biggie.
FOUR! Sanju Samson picking up the pace now. Full length, on middle and leg. Sanju Samson heaves across the line through square leg and beats the man in the deep to clout the ropes.
Full toss, on  middle. Iyer pushes it straight down the ground. The fielder from long off runs across and half-stops it but does enough to keep it away from the fence.
Slants it on the pads, flicked to deep square leg for a single.
Wide! Short ball and angling down. Left alone. Wided.
On middle. Iyer turns it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
TWO WIDES! Length ball, down the leg side. Samson misses his flick and the keeper does well to get a hand on it. A single stolen.
Length and on middle. Iyer works it to deep square leg for a single.
SIX! Iyer in sublime form! Short of a length, outside off. Iyer waits and ramps it over backward point for a biggie. The ball clashes on the cushion and given as a maximum.
Length and on middle, played back to the bowler.
Length, outside off. Shreyas Iyer pushes it to long off for a single.
SIX! FIFTY FOR IYER! Back of a length, on off. Shreyas Iyer pulls it powerfully over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
A length ball, on off. Samson works it towards mid on for a single.
On a length, on middle and leg. Shreyas Iyer flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
A short ball, on off. Sanju Samson looks to pull it away. The ball flies off the outer half towards deep mid-wicket. It lands short of the fielder. They take one.
A length ball, on middle and leg. Shreyas Iyer nudges it to mid-wicket for a single.

DRINKS! India need 104 runs off 60 deliveries. They have lost their openers inside the Powerplay, but Shreyas Iyer looks in some sublime form. He holds the key for them. The longer he stays the better it is for India. Sri Lanka have bowled with fire and would look to take quick wickets and put the hosts under some pressure. A good passage of play awaits.
A length ball, on middle. Iyer looks to flick it but gets an inside edge and gets hit near the box. The ball rolls onto the off side and they take a quick single.
Slower one, on middle. Samson bunts it to deep mid-wicket for one more.
Fuller and outside off, Iyer flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
A pacy short ball, on off. Samson rides the pull and hits it to long on for a single.
On middle, this is hit to deep square leg for a couple of runs.
FOUR! Good attempt there! A length ball, on middle. Samson pulls it hard and towards deep square leg. The fielder charges forward and covers good ground but he fails to catch it. A boundary.
Change. Dasun Shanaka comes into the attack now.
Darted on the pads, this is nudged to deep square leg for a single.
Now drives it nicely to deep cover for a single.
Fuller and on middle. Iyer tries to drive but gets an inside edge back to the bowler.
SIX! Again comes down the track and the result is the same! Flatter and angling outside off. Shreyas Iyer dances down and hammers it over wide long on for a maximum.
SIX! Much needed one! A flipper, around off. Iyer comes down the track and lifts it over long on for a biggie.
Tossed up, on middle, pushed to the right of Praveen Jayawickrama and he puts a dive to stop it.
A length ball, slower and on middle. Samson tucks it to mid-wicket and takes a couple of runs. Good running there but India need boundaries.
A fuller ball, outside off. Samson tries to drive straight and he misses. The ball just whizzes past the off pole.
A length ball, outside off. Samson makes room and looks to cut but gets a bottom edge to covers.
Short ball now, on middle. Iyer pulls it late and to deep square leg for one more.
Around off, on a length, pulled to long on for a single.
Length ball, outside off. Iyer steers it to third man for one.
A slider, outside off, coming with the angle. Samson looks to push but gets beaten on the inside edge.
Tossed up, on middle. Samson bunts it to mid-wicket.
Fuller and outside off, driven through covers for a single.
Flatter and on middle. Iyer wrists it to square leg for a couple of runs. 50 up for India.
Another single as Samson tucks it to fine leg.
On middle, this is hit to mid-wicket for a single.
On the pads, flicked to deep mid-wicket for a single. India lose both the openers in the Powerplay as they are 46 for 2 at the end of it.
Length and on middle. Samson looks to block it but does so off the inner half to mid-wicket and he takes a single.
Length ball, slower and outside off, pushed to point.

Review! Lahiru Kumara convinces his skipper to take it upstairs. The onfield decision is NOT OUT. The UltraEdge confirms there is some bat on it. The on-field decision stands and Sri Lanka lose a review.

NOT OUT! A length ball, angling around off. Samson looks to drive but misses and gets hit on the pads. A huge appeal follows for LBW but nothing given. They take the review and the replay shows there was a thick inside edge.
Length ball, outside off. Samson hops and defends it.
Sanju Samson is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Kumara is pumped up as he gets the big wicket. A soft dismissal there! On a length, on middle. Kishan tries to use his wrists and clear the man at mid on. Although he fails to middle it and ends up chipping it straight down the throat of Dasun Shanaka who gathers the ball with ease. India lose their second batter in no time. Ishan Kishan could never get going and as soon as he tried to break the shackles, he ended up giving away his wicket.
Commentary.Howout: c Dasun Shanaka b Lahiru Kumara

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Three boundaries on the trot. Shreyas Iyer wants to make the most of the Powerplay. A low full toss, on off. Iyer drives it down the ground for a boundary at long off. 14 runs off the over.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries. Shreyas Iyer is in his groove. A short ball, on off. Shreyas Iyer stands tall and pulls it between long on and deep mid-wicket to bag another boundary.
FOUR! Nicely played. A short ball, on off. Shreyas Iyer comes forward and pull it in front of him past mid on for a boundary. This is a glorious hit.
A length ball, angled across, on off. Shreyas Iyer gets it back to the bowler off the inner half.
Fuller, on off. Ishan Kishan eases it to mid off for an easy single.
Full length, outside off. Iyer guides it through backward point.
A dot to end the over. A short ball, just outside off. Ishan Kishan stays back and tries to pull it away. He fails to get any bat on it.
A length ball, on off. Iyer pushes it to cover for one.
FOUR! Streaky! Back of a length, outside off, shaping away. Shreyas Iyer tries to cut it away but finds the outside edge. It flies past the slip fielder and finds the fence at third man.
Full length outside off. Ishan Kishan throws his blade at it. The ball flies of the toe-end towards third man. They take one.
Halt in play! Ishan Kishan gets hit on the helmet. He sits down and looks like he just needs a breather. A concussion protocol follows as well.

OUCH! This must've hurt. Back of a length, on middle and leg. Ishan Kishan looks to pull it away but misses. He gets hit hard on his helmet. Lahiru Kumara walks towards the batter and has a check on him.
LEG BYE! Good length, around off, nips in a long way. Shreyas Iyer hops and tries to flick it away but misses. The ball brushes off the pads. They cross for a leg bye.
Change. Lahiru Kumara is into the attack now.

LEG BYE! A length ball, on the pads, some extra bounce off the deck. Shreyas Iyer stays back and tries to flick it away but misses. The ball hit him on the pads. Dushmantha Chameera appeals but the umpire says no. They collect a leg bye.
Full length, outside off. Ishan Kishan drives it to cover for one.
Length, on off. Iyer pushes it to mid off for one.
Woah! This was close. An outswinger, full and just besides the off pole. Shreyas Iyer moves too much into the crease and gets beaten by the swing.
A length ball, outside off. Shreyas Iyer pushes it to point.
A length ball, on the pads. Ishan Kishan gets it towards third man off the leading edge. They take one.
WIDE! Back of a length, going down leg. Ishan Kishan stands back and looks to pull it away but misses. Wide called.
Length ball, on off, blocked out solidly.

FOUR! Shreyas Iyer gets off the mark in fine fashion. Full length, on the stumps. Shreyas Iyer steps forward and drives it down the ground. Binura Fernando gets a strong hand on it but the ball still manages to race away to the long off fence.
Length ball, on middle and leg. Ishan Kishan flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Nearly chopped on! Back of a length, on off. It gets some extra bounce off the deck. Ishan Kishan gets it off the bottom half, as the sneaks past the stumps.

FOUR! Ishan Kishan gets his second boundary of the chase but this time he gets very lucky. A length ball, outside off, shaping away a hint. Ishan Kishan looks to drive it through covers, it takes the outside edge and goes past slips and into the boundary at third man.
A length ball, on the stumps. Ishan Kishan defends it into the deck.
Shreyas Iyer is the new batter in. Binura Fernando to bowl from the other end.

OUT! CHOPPED ON! Early success for Sri Lanka and Dushmantha Chameera gets rid of Rohit Sharma for just one. This is a huge wicket for the visitors. A good-length ball, on the fourth stump line. Rohit Sharma tries to defend it out with soft hands but gets an inside edge. The ball goes onto shatter the stumps.
Fuller, on leg. Ishan Kishan flicks it off his pads to deep square leg for one.
WIDE! A full-length ball, sliding down leg. Ishan Kishan tries to flick it away but misses. Wide called.
A length ball, on off, Ishan Kishan gets an inside edge onto the pads.
FOUR! What a shot! A full-length ball, on off. Ishan Kishan gets his blade down in time and steers it through backward point for a boundary.
A length ball, on the pads. Kishan stays back and flicks it to deep square leg for a brace. He gets off the mark as well.
Rohit Sharma and India are off the mark. A length ball, on leg. Rohit Sharma nudges it to square leg for one.
